Minimum Graduation Credits (Hours)

Remarks

  • According to the "Tzu Chi University's Implementation Guidelines for English Required Courses for the Four-Year Program," English proficiency placement tests will be administered, and students will be divided into three levels: "Basic English," "Intermediate English," and "Advanced English" for class placement and instruction.

  • Four-Year Program students must complete at least 8 credits of general education electives, with the freedom to choose from the four major dimensions, but may select no more than two courses from each dimension.

  • The graduation requirements for students in this department are as follows:

    • (1) Students must pass the "Business Management Department Professional Certification Graduation Requirement."
    • (2) Students must participate in the graduation thesis presentation (or project result presentation).
    • (3) Students must complete and pass one professional bilingual course.

  • Major Elective Courses will be based on the actual courses offered in the current semester.

Approved by the University Curriculum Committee on 111.02.09
